note: Events are computed in the VIIRS era only (2012 →); MODIS-only footprints before 2012 are not comparable. Footprint = area of ~2.2 km cells with detections, NOT burned area.
filter_note: Events always use the default filter (nominal+high confidence, vegetation fires).
sentence: The largest recent (last 7 days) fire event (2026-11-09 → 2026-11-10, footprint ≈ 17 km²) is the 22nd largest of 2,015 fire events recorded here since 2012, and ranks 36th by duration (2 days).
